name: বাজার নোট
status: Working Bengali Next.js app implemented locally; not publicly deployed or piloted
userTask: Prepare a shopping list using personal prices, see the total against a budget and send the list to another household member.
audienceHypothesis: Adults who plan household shopping, including students who share grocery costs. Whether they will enter prices manually is untested; this is not a national audience estimate.
boundedV1: One Bangla-first basket with editable item name, quantity, unit and price per selected unit.
Support piece, hali, kg and litre without unit conversion; clearly label each price basis.
Calculate each line total, basket total and difference from an optional BDT budget.
Save one current basket on the device; show saved state and provide clear all.
Download a plain-text list or print it. Exclude prices and budget by default; let the user explicitly include them.
exclusions: Live market prices, scraping, crowdsourced submissions and retailer recommendations.
Accounts, cloud sync, payment, delivery and cross-device collaboration.
Price forecasts, claimed savings, meal plans and financial advice.
Historical basket comparison and automatic unit conversion.
journey: Add an item and choose its quantity and unit.
Enter the known or estimated price per selected unit.
Review line totals; add a budget only if useful.
Edit or remove items until the list is ready.
Preview the export, choose whether to include money amounts and download or print.
Reopen the current basket for a second shopping trip or clear it.
differentiator: A private editable household list using the user's own prices. Kombeshi already advertises shopping lists and retailer price comparisons; DAM publishes market information; BazarBoard advertises community price reports. The proposed gap is a simple personal workflow, not unique price discovery. Paper lists, calculators and family chats are the main alternatives.

dataAndPrivacy.content: No external price feed. Label every amount as entered by the user and not verified live market data.
dataAndPrivacy.userData: Store only the current basket and optional budget in localStorage. Send neither to a server nor into public URLs.
dataAndPrivacy.storageFailure: If storage is blocked, full or unreadable, show that saving failed and preserve the visible basket. Do not overwrite unreadable stored data silently; offer an explicit reset.
dataAndPrivacy.deletion: Clear all removes the saved basket only after a clear user action. Explain that clearing browser data also removes it.
dataAndPrivacy.sharing: Preview the exact exported content; default to item names, quantities and units without money amounts.
dataAndPrivacy.pilotRecords: Use consenting household IDs and manual repeat-use tallies; do not collect their budgets or item-level spending.

acceptanceCriteria: Add, edit, remove, save, reopen, export and clear a basket on a 360px-wide screen with accessible labels and keyboard controls.
Accept Bangla and Latin digits. Reject blank, negative, non-finite or malformed values; quantities must be positive and prices may be zero. Limit amounts to two decimal places.
Calculate prices in integer poisha and quantities in hundredths; round each line once to the nearest poisha and sum line totals.
The displayed and exported totals match. A check confirms 1.50 kg at Tk120.50 totals Tk180.75 and two pieces at Tk10 total Tk20.
Budget difference is labeled as remaining or over budget; a negative result is never hidden.
Unit and price basis remain explicit after reopening and exporting; changing a unit never silently converts a quantity or price.
Money amounts remain absent from the default export and appear only after explicit selection.
Storage and export errors preserve the visible basket and tell the user what failed.
A network inspection confirms that basket contents and budget stay on the device.

manualPilot.status: Proposed decision threshold; no pilot has run
manualPilot.task: Use the tool during two real shopping trips. Include students who share a household basket where relevant.
manualPilot.repeatDefinition: A household chooses to use the tool on its second trip without a researcher prompting it to do so.
manualPilot.records: Manually record first-use completion, entry burden, sharing usefulness and second-trip use with consent.
manualPilot.interpretation: Eight of 15 repeating would justify another small iteration. It would not establish savings or national product demand.

nextJsArchitecture.publicPage: App Router server page for instructions, privacy explanation, metadata and public link preview.
nextJsArchitecture.interaction: One client basket editor owns user entries and storage status.
nextJsArchitecture.calculation: One small pure module parses amounts and computes line totals, basket total and budget difference; the UI and export use the same result.
nextJsArchitecture.storage: Read and validate one localStorage record in the browser; no compatibility migrations or cloud layer.
nextJsArchitecture.export: Native Blob text download and print CSS; use the same basket data and explicit export choice.
nextJsArchitecture.backend: None. No API routes, price service, database or authentication.
nextJsArchitecture.checks: Small assertions for fractional quantities, Bangla digits, rounding, invalid amounts and an over-budget basket; manual reopen/export and storage-failure checks.

dependenciesToCheckBeforeAdd: Inspect package.json, lockfile and existing form, money and storage helpers when implementation begins.
Use installed Next.js, React and TypeScript if present; read current Next.js documentation before setup.
Use native localStorage, Blob downloads, Intl formatting and printing. No spreadsheet, money, database or UI package is needed for this bounded version.
If an installed validation package already fits the project, use its documented capabilities before adding another package.
risks: Manual entry may cost more effort than the current habit; the second-trip pilot must test this.
Entered prices can be wrong or outdated. Do not present them as an official price or promised saving.
A price entered per kg versus per purchased packet changes the total; clear unit labeling is essential.
Local records are lost when browser data is cleared and are visible to others who use the same browser profile.

sources.supports: Reported household cost pressure; manual-entry product demand remains untested.
Historical inflation context; not current item prices.
BazarBoard's advertised community price workflow; accuracy and adoption not audited.

sources.name: Kombeshi
sources.supports: Existing shopping-list and retailer-price comparison claims; freshness and accuracy not audited.

sources.name: Department of Agricultural Marketing
sources.supports: Existing official market-information service; do not embed an unchecked moving price feed.
